skill.name: video-edit
skill.description: Routes video editing requests to RunComfy models for restyling, background changes, packaging swaps, outfit edits, and reference-based motion transfer.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting, placeholder URLs, or documented paths and are false positives. Confirmed findings cover visible CLI commands, unpinned installations, and intentional third-party processing of prompts and media. No prompt injection or covert behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Installation commands do not pin package or skill versions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the RunComfy CLI version and the skill source commit, then document integrity verification for both dependencies.

remediation.issue: Prompts and media URLs are processed by an external RunComfy service.
remediation.suggestion: Request user confirmation before submission and document the provider's storage, retention, and privacy terms.

remediation.issue: The skill executes installation, authentication, and model commands.
remediation.suggestion: Keep every command visible, require confirmation for installation and login, and restrict output directories to user-approved locations.

content.user_title: Edit Videos with Intent-Matched AI Models
content.value_statement: Choosing the wrong video model wastes time and may reduce visual consistency. This skill routes each edit to a suitable RunComfy model with tailored prompts.
actual_capabilities: Classifies edit intent and selects Wan 2.7, Kling 2.6, or Lucy Edit Restyle.
Creates model-specific instructions that prioritize identity, motion, framing, and audio preservation.
Supports background changes, packaging replacement, outfit edits, visual restyling, and reference-based motion transfer.
Applies model-specific duration, resolution, orientation, and input requirements.
Runs the selected model through the RunComfy CLI and downloads the result.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account, and accessible media URLs.
Uses one model per request and does not blend outputs across routes.
Wan accepts short clips, Kling limits duration by orientation, and Lucy outputs only 720p.
Prompts and media URLs are processed by an external RunComfy service.

use_cases.title: Restyle Social Videos
use_cases.description: Change a background or visual style while preserving the presenter, motion, lip movement, and audio.

use_cases.title: Update Product Packaging
use_cases.description: Apply a reference packaging design while retaining hand movement, framing, and camera motion.

use_cases.title: Transfer Character Motion
use_cases.description: Map motion from a reference clip onto a target character while maintaining identity and scene consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Replace a Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [video URL]. Preserve the subject and motion. Change only the background to [description]. Keep original audio.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Visual Restyle
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle [video URL] with [look]. Preserve face, pose, framing, lip movement, and audio. Use the best supported model.
prompt_templates.scenario: A controlled visual treatment for an existing clip.

prompt_templates.title: Replace Product Packaging
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace packaging in [video URL] using [reference image URL]. Preserve hand movement, framing, camera motion, and original audio.

prompt_templates.title: Transfer Reference Motion
prompt_templates.prompt: Transfer motion from [reference video URL] to [target image or video URL]. Preserve identity and background. Keep source sound: [yes/no].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced motion mapping from one source to another.

output_examples.input: Restyle a talking-head clip with a modern office background while preserving audio.
output_examples.output: Selected Wan 2.7 Edit-Video. The edit preserves face, pose, lip movement, framing, and original audio while replacing the background.

output_examples.input: Replace product packaging using a supplied reference image.
output_examples.output: Selected Wan 2.7 Edit-Video with the reference image. The result path is reported after RunComfy finishes.

output_examples.input: Transfer dance motion from a reference clip to a target character.
output_examples.output: Selected Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control. Motion follows the reference while target identity and scene remain consistent.

best_practices: State preservation goals before the requested visual change.
Request one focused edit per call to reduce temporal drift.
Confirm media rights, privacy expectations, output location, and audio handling before submission.
anti_patterns: Do not combine unrelated background, wardrobe, identity, and motion changes in one request.
Do not use Lucy for complete subject replacement or high-resolution output.
Do not submit confidential media or private URLs without authorization for third-party processing.

faq.question: Which model does the skill choose by default?
faq.answer: It chooses Wan 2.7 Edit-Video when the request does not clearly require motion transfer or lightweight localized restyling.

faq.question: Can it preserve original audio?
faq.answer: Yes. Wan and Kling expose audio preservation options. Audio behavior depends on the selected route.

faq.question: Can it transfer motion from another video?
faq.answer: Yes. Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control maps reference motion onto a target image or video.

faq.question: Does it support reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. Wan supports reference-guided design transfer, and Kling uses images for target character consistency.

faq.question: What resolution can it produce?
faq.answer: Wan supports up to 1080p. Lucy is limited to 720p. Kling output depends on its route settings.

faq.question: Where is the media processed?
faq.answer: RunComfy receives the request and its model servers fetch supplied media URLs. Review provider privacy terms before using sensitive content.
